TextView.android:text: Global performance profiles: Cheetah (Gaming), Kachua (Battery), or AI Balance.
Custom profiles: Force FPS, Sampling rate, and CPU priority for specific apps.
Hibernation: Automatically stop background apps on screen-off or manually freeze all at once.
Charging protection, cycles tracking, and deep standby power management.
Kernel-level deep sleep for 0% standby drain.
Modem Lock: Force connect to specific 5G/4G cells to prevent signal drops.
Switch between 1080p and 720p for performance boost.
UFS Speed: Weekly FSTRIM and I/O tuning to keep storage as fast as new.
Disable or remove unused system applications.
ZRAM Engine: Efficient 4GB compressed RAM (In-Memory) for 50x faster multitasking than disk-based Virtual RAM.
Stable Ping: Enable TCP BBR and packet marking to prioritize gaming traffic.
Cooling Engine: Dynamic CPU capping and core parking to prevent overheating.
Maintenance: Clean system junk and rebuild ART cache for peak responsiveness.
Execute raw shell/ADB commands as root.
